config.pi.executablePath.description: Path to the `pi` launcher or to node. Empty = auto-detect.
config.pi.cliEntryPath.description: Path to pi's dist/bundle/cli.js. Empty = auto-detect.
config.pi.nodePath.description: node.exe used to run pi (preferred on Windows).
config.pi.model.description: provider/modelId. Empty = keep Pi's default model.
config.pi.enableTui.description: Show the "Open in Terminal" TUI entry (when off, the menu, slash command and session tree entries are hidden too).
config.pi.multiSession.markdownDescripti: Deprecated: parallel sessions are always available (session tab strip ＋ / `Pi: New Parallel Session`). This setting no longer has any effect.
config.pi.multiSession.deprecationMessag: Parallel sessions are always available; this setting no longer has any effect.
config.pi.reviewOnSave.enabled.descripti: Ask Pi to review a file right after you save it.
config.pi.shadowGit.externalPolicy.descr: Policy for recording changes outside the workspace: explicitWrites = only tool writes (recommended), allowlistOnly = allowlist only, all = every candidate.
config.pi.shadowGit.externalAllowlist.de: Extra out-of-workspace root folders that may be snapshotted (absolute paths).
config.pi.shadowGit.redactSecrets.descri: For suspected secret files only the path, size and sha256 are recorded — never the content.
config.pi.shadowGit.snapshotMode.markdow: **Deprecated**: the shadow repo always commits once per finished conversation turn. The key is kept only for settings compatibility.
config.pi.shadowGit.baseMode.description: Scope of the base snapshot: auto = try full, fall back to candidates-only above the size limit.
config.pi.shadowGit.usePiExtension.descr: Inject --extension shadow-snapshot.ts automatically; fall back to L1+L3 if that fails.
config.pi.showDiagnosticsOnError.descrip: Open the diagnostics panel automatically when the Pi process fails to start.
